entities.name: PMID:27498122
observations: Prospective multicenter cohort of 400 hemodynamically stable acute PE patients aged ≥65; TTE RV dysfunction was not associated with 30-day mortality after adjustment (HR 0.90, 95% CI 0.31–2.58).

entities.name: Stable elderly PE TTE mortality
observations: In a prospective multicenter cohort of stable acute PE patients aged ≥65, TTE RV dysfunction did not independently predict 30-day mortality (adjusted HR 0.90, 95% CI 0.31–2.58); evidence does not support TTE as a stand-alone mortality risk tool in this population.

entities.name: PMID:33999379
observations: Observational cohort of acute PE patients reported basal RV diameter and TAPSE <16 mm independently associated with in-hospital mortality; elderly-specific and hemodynamically stable subgroup estimates were not reported.
